_comment: Q9-AF v3 JOB B (runner q9af_v3_job.sh B): fetch the pinned stage-A artifact (+ v2's job-7ji99 export when pinned) -> 32k long-context KD (45 min) -> on-policy reverse-KL (40 min) -> final export -> proxy600 under the generic v3w readout (PR #236; identity 2e4907ee...): stock, v3, v2 -> the gate (rule.decide: PROMOTE iff CI lo of v3 - reference > 0; reference = v2 iff the v2 block below is pinned, else stock). The stageA / v2 blocks are filled by `python -m jobs.q9af_v3.artifact fill` (which also adds the URL placeholder to submit.env) in their own commit before B is packaged for real. Billing basis as job A.

allowed_skips.why: the launcher stages a git archive (no .git); these tests run in the PR checkout

measured._comment: job-5cmat (art-2bybh) and job-2xe5w (art-ipnxz, receipts/2026-10-07-D-full8/result.json). stage1 rate = 5cmat stage 1 (all 8 layers aligned, the same shape as v2 stage 1). Stage 2 worst rate = 2xe5w step 7 (layer 3 + 6 more GDNs training: first student layer 3, the v2 shape) and the FLOP model at the 4j3vu layer-3 MFU. Peak = 2xe5w (7 GDNs attached, 7 training).

estimates_not_measured._comment: No receipt: 32k KD rate = 0.77 x the 2xe5w layer-3 stage-2 rate (teacher attention at 32k adds ~12% FLOP/token); on-policy step = 64 rollouts x 256 new tokens (cached student decode) + one reverse-KL step on ~64 x 1k tokens; artifact downloads ~4.3 GB.

stageA._comment: job A's /output artifact; filled by `artifact fill --which stageA` after job A ends

v2._comment: job-7ji99's /output artifact (v2 clean); filled by `artifact fill --which v2` iff it exported an attention-free gdn_converted.pt. Pinned -> reference = v2; unpinned -> reference = stock (rule.expected_reference).

submit._comment: submit_job fields not in the top-level params (jobs/common/launch.py). env gets STAGEA_URL / V2_URL placeholders from `artifact fill`; sf_submit fills them from the shell at submit time.
submit.label: q9af_v3 B: 32k long-context + on-policy distillation of the stage-A Q9-AF, then the proxy600 gate under the generic v3w readout (v3 vs v2, else vs stock)

context._comment: the q9af_v2 image (CMD rewritten) + code + the PRIVATE DEV rows (proxy600 arms) + the Qwen3.5-9B tokenizer.json / tokenizer_config.json the v3w readout identity 2e4907ee... was built from (sha256 pinned). The 2 GB GDN artifacts are NOT in the context: the job streams them from the signed URLs and checks every byte (jobs.q9af_v3.artifact).
